description: Get heatmap grid data for a map (analytics:read). Legacy text is unchanged; structuredContent.cells contains the same complete cell subset, with total/returned/truncated describing response truncation, not ingestion readiness. Context filter strings are prefixes when listed in context.truncated_fields. Coordinates and cell_size use engine world units, not image pixels. Consult list_maps for upAxis/bounds: Y-up maps (Unity, Godot) use x/z and omit y; otherwise x/y. Null metric causes are unknown.

map_id.description: Map ID to query (accepts the row UUID or slug from list_maps)

name: get_heatmap
title: Get Heatmap
